verdict.rationale: Gmail exposes a full REST API (send, read, push notifications) plus IMAP/SMTP support that lets automation/backends interact with Gmail programmatically without a UI, which is the basis for headless/CI usage [gmail-docs-1][gmail-docs-20][gmail-docs-21][gmail-docs-27][gmail-docs-7]. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI-oriented workflows, service-account/headless OAuth setup, rate-limit guidance for automated pipelines, or SDK examples for CI, and community notes flag real limitations in Gmail's IMAP implementation for automation use cases [gmail-comm-1][gmail-comm-2]. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless auth (service accounts, workload identity) guidance, CI pipeline examples, and independent confirmation that automated scripts run reliably at scale.
